what: Hovering over the list scales a preview card from 0 to 1 over .6s cubic-bezier(.65,.1,0,1) and attaches it at the cursor center, then it follows each frame by lagging .1 of the remaining distance. It tilts by the horizontal follow speed × 1.5 (max ±12°, the tilt also catches up at .1), so a quick sideways swipe makes the card sway and lie down, and it stands straight again as soon as it stops. The image inside the card switches per row in .1s

options.tilt: Tilt angle at horizontal speed 1 (px/frame), default 1.5
options.[data-fx-part=item]: A single list row (its order matches the image order)
options.look: Quick mode, brand type — the card chases with quickTo(dur, power3), and the tilt follows the last horizontal movement × tilt (default .6, ±max default 8°) over dur+.2s and stays as it is when movement stops. The card grows from .85→1 scale (.6s), and when you change rows the image opens clipped from top to bottom and settles from 1.15 scale over .8s.
options.dur: Chase duration in look: quick (sec), default .7

from.where: list.html .roster__follow (director roster — original directors-hero_preview-follower · speed .1 · ROTATION_FACTOR 1.5 · MAX_ROTATION 12)
index.html preview above the ‹Selected work› list rows (look: quick)

note: Applied only at 992px and up on hover devices, on phones the card is hidden
